# Retana Services Tamarindo

> Shared shuttles and private transfers in Guanacaste, Costa Rica, since 2015.
> Guaranteed daily departures from Tamarindo to Liberia Airport (LIR) and major
> destinations. No minimum passengers. Shared from $30/person; private transfers
> priced per vehicle. Online booking with confirmation by email and WhatsApp.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://retanaservices.com/): service overview, live routes and online booking
- [Routes](https://retanaservices.com/routes): all active shuttle routes with prices and schedules
- [Book](https://retanaservices.com/book): search departures and reserve seats
- [Blog](https://retanaservices.com/blog): travel guides for Tamarindo and Guanacaste
- [About](https://retanaservices.com/about): who we are and our service area
- [Contact](https://retanaservices.com/contact): WhatsApp, email and hours
- [FAQ](https://retanaservices.com/faq): booking, luggage, flight delays and payment
- [Cancellation policy](https://retanaservices.com/cancellation): refunds and no-show terms
